Name: Havvoth-jair
Description: The towns of Jair: the villages Jair son of Manasseh took in Gilead and Bashan and called after his own name, later counted among the towns of the judge Jair the Gileadite and listed in Solomon's districts.
BiblicalSignificance: Havvoth-jair shows a family name becoming geography: one man's conquests turned into a lasting region on Israel's eastern frontier.
KeyScriptures: Numbers 32:41; Deuteronomy 3:14; Joshua 13:30; Judges 10:4; 1 Kings 4:13; 1 Chronicles 2:23
RelatedBooks: Numbers; Deuteronomy; Joshua; Judges; 1 Kings; 1 Chronicles
RelatedPeople: Jair, Son of Manasseh; Jair, the Gileadite
